title: Sample change: greeting endpoint + home banner

claims.question: What does the change do to the home page and API when the service actually runs?
claims.conclusion: The home page renders the new greeting banner, and the service log shows the /api/greeting route being served.

claims.question: Does the change affect other callers of greeting()?
claims.conclusion: Probably not: greeting() is a new pure function only used by the two new code paths. Not exercised at runtime here.
